candidates.name: Sword
candidates.description: Both companies provide AI-powered virtual physical therapy and digital musculoskeletal care solutions for employers and health plans, directly competing with hingehealth.com.
candidates.rationale: Direct competitor in digital MSK care and virtual physical therapy for employers and health plans.

candidates.name: Vori Health, Inc.
candidates.description: Both companies offer a virtual-first musculoskeletal clinic model providing integrated care for joint and muscle pain similar to hingehealth.com.
candidates.rationale: Virtual-first MSK care clinic serving similar pain-management customers and buyer persona as Hinge Health.

candidates.name: RecoveryOne
candidates.description: Both companies provide virtual musculoskeletal care and digital therapy programs designed to reduce recovery costs for employers, mirroring the hingehealth.com model.
candidates.rationale: Same digital MSK care model for employers; clear competitive lookalike to Hinge Health.

candidates.name: Kiio
candidates.description: Both companies offer digital therapeutics and personalized MSK pain management via mobile applications for employer populations like hingehealth.com.
candidates.rationale: Same digital MSK care model for employer populations; direct lookalike to Hinge Health.

candidates.name: Limber Health, Inc.
candidates.description: Both companies provide digital musculoskeletal platforms focused on remote monitoring and home exercise programs for joint health similar to hingehealth.com.
candidates.rationale: Same digital MSK care category, similar remote monitoring and home exercise programs, targeting overlapping healthcare buyers.

candidates.name: SimpleTherapy Inc.
candidates.description: Both companies offer personalized virtual musculoskeletal care and digital exercise therapy for employees and health plans like hingehealth.com.
candidates.rationale: Direct same-category competitor: virtual MSK care and digital exercise therapy for employers and health plans.

candidates.name: SpineZone Medical Fitness, Inc.
candidates.description: Both companies focus on non-invasive digital and clinical programs specifically for chronic back and joint pain management similar to hingehealth.com.
candidates.rationale: Same MSK/back-and-joint pain management category with digital/clinical therapy programs; plausible competing lookalike for the same buyers.

candidates.name: Bardavon
candidates.description: Both companies provide musculoskeletal recovery solutions and clinical guidance for injured workers and employers, overlapping with the hingehealth.com enterprise focus.
candidates.rationale: Similar digital MSK recovery platform for employers and injured workers; overlapping care model, buyer persona, and enterprise market.

candidates.name: IncludeHealth Inc.
candidates.description: Both companies utilize virtual platforms and motion technology to deliver physical therapy and MSK treatment at home like hingehealth.com.
candidates.rationale: Same digital MSK/virtual physical therapy model with motion tech and at-home treatment for similar buyers.

candidates.name: Phzio
candidates.description: Both companies provide a telehealth-based physiotherapy platform for remote musculoskeletal rehabilitation and employee health management similar to hingehealth.com.
candidates.rationale: Same digital MSK/tele-physio care model for remote rehabilitation and employee health, serving overlapping buyers and use cases.
